story.opening1: This world was once full of words. People spoke without having to think.
story.opening2: Then The Silence came, and the words began to be forgotten.
story.opening3: A word forgotten long enough twists into a monster. It is not evil. It is only lost.
story.opening4: You are a Word Keeper. You free a word by understanding it.
story.opening5: Your knowledge is your weapon. Go — the village is waiting.
story.chapterComplete: Chapter 1 is over. The village has its words back. The Silence does not.
